objective: Compare broad daily Japanese-equity rule families under identical execution constraints; select the configuration that produces the highest holdout profit after discovery-only exit selection.

data.execution: Yahoo Finance/yfinance Japanese daily OHLCV using existing raw split reconstruction

common.entry: next session open after signal close

entries.ma75_reclaim: SMA75>SMA75[-5] AND SMA25>SMA75 AND Close<=SMA25 AND Close[-1]<=SMA75[-1] AND Close>SMA75
entries.breakout20_vol15: Close > prior 20-session highest High AND Volume >= 1.5*prior 20-session median Volume
entries.reversal5_bottom10: 5-session return is <= cross-sectional 10th percentile among eligible stocks on signal date
entries.reversal10_bottom10: 10-session return is <= cross-sectional 10th percentile among eligible stocks on signal date
entries.reversal20_bottom10: 20-session return is <= cross-sectional 10th percentile among eligible stocks on signal date
entries.momentum20_top10: 20-session return is >= cross-sectional 90th percentile among eligible stocks on signal date
entries.momentum60_top10: 60-session return is >= cross-sectional 90th percentile among eligible stocks on signal date
entries.sma25_reclaim_uptrend: SMA75>SMA75[-5] AND SMA25>SMA75 AND Close[-1]<=SMA25[-1] AND Close>SMA25

exits.fixed_3d_1p5R: initial stop active; target entry+1.5R; otherwise exit third holding session close; if daily bar touches stop and target same day, stop first
exits.trail_2ATR: no target; after each survived close next-day stop=max(previous stop, highest high since entry - 2*ATR14(current close)); never lower
exits.sma20_break: initial stop active; if survived close < SMA20, exit next session open
exits.sma75_break: initial stop active; if survived close < SMA75, exit next session open

selection.stage1: For each entry family, choose one exit using discovery only: highest ending equity at 0.10% round-trip cost among configs with >=10 completed trades; if none have >=10, choose highest ending equity and flag low_n.
selection.stage2: Evaluate only the 12 discovery-selected family champions on untouched holdout.
selection.winner: highest holdout ending equity at 0.10% cost. Also report 0.20% stress. Do not modify rules after holdout is seen.
selection.full_sample_oracle: May be reported only as descriptive overfit benchmark and may not determine winner.
